official_measurement_examples.name: Same-class movement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Movement between primary uses within the same use class is generally not development for planning purposes; associated works can still need separate consent.

official_measurement_examples.name: Material change fact and degree
official_measurement_examples.fact: Whether a change of use is material is a matter of fact and degree; labels alone do not determine the answer.

official_measurement_examples.name: Class E breadth
official_measurement_examples.fact: Class E groups multiple commercial, business and service uses; same-class flexibility does not remove separate controls on physical works or conditions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Sui generis
official_measurement_examples.fact: Uses outside a defined class can be sui generis; change to or from such uses often requires local planning consideration unless a specific right applies.

official_measurement_examples.name: Permitted development separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: A permitted development right can grant planning permission subject to limitations and prior approval; the Use Classes Order itself is not a blanket permission for associated works.

official_measurement_examples.name: Class MA
official_measurement_examples.fact: Class MA is a specific GPDO route from Class E to C3 subject to its own limitations and prior-approval requirements.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning history
official_measurement_examples.fact: Historic permissions, conditions and lawful-use evidence can constrain the practical effect of use-class flexibility.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Use-class categorisation does not establish ownership, building-regulations compliance or final development yield.

core_rules: same use class does not automatically cover physical works
material change is fact and degree
use class label is not planning history

sui generis is not a single uniform use class
UCO is distinct from GPDO permitted development rights
Class MA has separate limitations and prior approval
planning conditions can restrict otherwise available flexibility
LDC can be needed for certainty
use class does not establish ownership
use class does not establish title or access
use class does not calculate development yield
